logic_evidence.source_behavior: CharacterTargetMarkerV28::update uses Character+0x40c (CharAI last_target) as the preferred presentation candidate. If it is null or equals the player identity, it falls back to Character+0x14a4 (object of interest); if the fallback is also null/self, the owned marker is hidden. This does not assert that marker candidate equals current AI target, and the marker source intentionally has no alive filter. Character::Update calls UpdateObjectOfInterest at 0x3ac0b4. UpdateObjectOfInterest at 0x3abb9c validates the current OOI, refreshes on the source 500 ms timer, and runs its source candidate query. Candidate iteration/filtering and a genuine OOI projection remain caller-owned.
logic_evidence.current_callers: The recovered Android campaign frame passes target.last_target and source_ooi14a4 into CharacterTargetMarkerV28. Windows foundation main.cpp currently draws the world ring and projected target HUD from CombatSession::selectedactor() alone (main.cpp around lines 2805 and 2821). The current frozen DA4C player target_id reflects the current AI selection only; no last-target/OOI pair is projected to that renderer. CharacterTargetMarkerV28 preserves its current selection when the actual GetInteractionType provider returns a negative type; this helper does not model that subsequent lifecycle behavior. The source marker has no fabricated alive filter; AnimatedFX dead-anchor cleanup and source AI/OOI lifecycle own disappearance.
